services.desc: World premiere musical celebrating the legendary Stephen Schwartz songbook, highlighting six decades of songs from the beloved award-winning composer of Wicked, Pippin, Godspell, and other Broadway and Hollywood classics. For decades, Stephen Schwartz’s songs have celebrated dreamers, seekers, and those searching for their place in the world. Join us for a thoughtful discussion of the themes of aspiration, resilience, and belonging that have made his music resonate across generations. Travel back to 1967 with Jeffrey Hatcher’s charming comedy, Mrs. Mannerly!
